seen.front: Pip lowers his head between his front legs, keeps his paws planted, and holds his tail high.
seen.three_quarter: Pip points his nose down and forward, stands on four legs, and curls his tail upward.
seen.side: Pip lowers his nose toward the ground, keeps his rear raised, and holds his tail high.
seen.back: Pip dips his head between his shoulders, keeps his hind legs straight, and raises his tail.
seen.strip: The head bobs above the ground while the paws stay planted and the tail wags.

critical: The cream chest reads as a floating paw in the side view.
issues: The tongue slightly weakens the sniff read.
sprout-pip-sniff.fix: Join the cream chest visibly to the torso in the side view.
